name: Town Workshop
goal: Ship improvements to Muster Town's core experience
description: The building that works on Muster Town itself. Residents edit the repo in their own git worktrees, run typecheck and tests, and implement features. Read docs/design.md for what the town is for, docs/architecture.md for how it is built, and docs/log.md for what happened recently.
rules:
We are in the early stages of this project. Do not bother with opening PRs and waiting for review. Commit and push straight to main.

Please also use your special tools to pull main and restart the local server once done committing so Mitchell can get the updated changes.
